nodes.label: auth
nodes.note: Identidade: register/verify/login/refresh rotativo/logout/sessions/forgot/reset/change/mfa + GDPR. 15 rotas.

nodes.label: customers
nodes.note: PF/PJ, orgs/members, consents, GDPR. Stub x-identity-id + X-Org-Id.

nodes.label: products
nodes.note: Catálogo imutável products/versions/plans/features. Leitura aberta, escrita admin.

nodes.label: access
nodes.note: Verdade de acesso: check/check-batch (cache 60s), contracts/entitlements/bonus/adjustments/evaluate.

nodes.label: licensing
nodes.note: Core PG 8 rotas + DevicesController 6 + OfflineTokenController 1. LicensesController (flow) fora de propósito.

nodes.label: billing
nodes.note: Core PG Asaas 12 + flow 10 + webhooks 3 + reconcile. Prefixo /v1/billing.

nodes.label: finance
nodes.note: Core PG 14 + flow 13 (5 sombreadas) + projections 5 + sync 1. Saldo só em markReceived/markPaid.

nodes.label: communications
nodes.note: Webhook Resend POST /webhooks/resend (fora /v1), @Public, Svix opcional, sempre 200.

nodes.label: audit
nodes.note: Append-only, 0 rotas HTTP. Via AuditService.emit + interceptor.

nodes.label: admin-dlq
nodes.note: GET /v1/admin/dlq + POST replay (mode logical) + GET /admin/queues.

nodes.label: health
nodes.note: GET /health/live|ready + /metrics, @Public.

nodes.label: retention
nodes.note: 5 políticas LGPD, dry-run default, cron 30 3 * * * America/SP.

nodes.label: common-guards
nodes.note: Cadeia Jwt→Session→Mfa→Verified→Roles→CustomerScope + rate-limit + outbox + correlation-id.

nodes.label: workers
nodes.note: 11 queues + 4 tickers, jobId=eventId, retry 5x. Nunca escreve PG direto (x-internal-key).

nodes.label: admin-bff
nodes.note: 28 route.ts proxy-ou-mock, Idempotency-Key repassado.

nodes.label: fluxo-compra
nodes.note: Order→Invoice pending→Asaas→webhook 200 duplicate→Payment CONFIRMED→outbox→Entitlement+License→Receivable RECEBIDO+Transaction→e-mail.

nodes.label: licenca-offline
nodes.note: starts_at=PaymentConfirmed, expires +1M/12M, grace +3d degradado, off_exp=min(iat+7d,expires+7d). Chave só key_hash + keyMasked.

nodes.label: previsto-pendente-realizado
nodes.note: Só Transaction muta saldo (markReceived/markPaid mesma txn). Projeções scope/ref/hash: hit 200, miss 202+jobId.

nodes.label: terminais-nunca-regridem
nodes.note: TERMINAL_STATUSES + isOutOfOrderRegression; ilegal→422/REJECTED; replay idempotente.

nodes.label: billing.payment.confirmed.v1
nodes.note: Fanout: access + licensing + finance.sync + notifications.

nodes.label: licensing.license.*.v1
nodes.note: issued/renewed/revoked/suspended/revealed; cascata p/ access.

nodes.label: finance.transaction.posted.v1
nodes.note: Invalida período de projeções.

nodes.label: outbox-relay
nodes.note: Mesma txn eventId UNIQUE, relay SKIP LOCKED 100 jobId=eventId.

nodes.label: billing.webhook.apply
nodes.note: Worker aplica RECEIVED→VALIDATED→APPLIED via x-internal-key.

nodes.label: finance.sync
nodes.note: Espelho billing→finance por provider+externalId.

nodes.label: billing.recon
nodes.note: Hourly <7d + daily 03:00 SP 30d. Terminal nunca regride.

nodes.label: ASAAS_API_KEY
nodes.note: Header access_token. Começa com $: escapar $$ no .env p/ Compose.

nodes.label: ASAAS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
nodes.note: Validado no header asaas-access-token (timing-safe). Ausente = 503 fail-closed.

nodes.label: JWT_SECRET
nodes.note: ≥16 chars. Default de teste recusado em produção.

nodes.label: INTERNAL_WEBHOOK_KEY+INTERNAL_PROJECTION_KEY
nodes.note: worker→API (x-internal-key). Ausentes = 503/DLQ.

nodes.label: RESEND_API_KEY+RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET
nodes.note: Envio + validação Svix do webhook (opcional; sem secret aceita tudo).

nodes.label: POST /v1/billing/webhooks/asaas
nodes.note: @Public. Responde {received, duplicate, eventId}. URL pública p/ Asaas.

nodes.label: POST /webhooks/resend
nodes.note: @Public, fora /v1, sempre 200 (dedupe webhookId).

nodes.label: GET /health/live|ready + /metrics
nodes.note: ready 200 = postgres up + redis up. Sem auth.

nodes.label: /v1/auth/* (15)
nodes.note: Públicas: register/verify/resend/login/refresh/forgot/reset. Resto JWT+Session.

nodes.label: /v1/finance/*
nodes.note: Core PG canônico + flow-only (ingest/balance/grants/projections/audit/metrics). finance.read escopado.

nodes.label: /v1/licenses/* (15)
nodes.note: Core 8 + devices 6 + offline 1. Reveal: MFA + 10/h + audit.

nodes.label: design-system
nodes.note: Aurum DS v1: tokens light/dark, Tailwind, P0 (Button/Field/Table/Dialog/Badge), showcase em /ds. Fonte única travada.

nodes.label: /mfa + BFF /api/auth/mfa/*
nodes.note: Enroll (QR + chave) + verify 6 dígitos auto-submit. Mock aceita qualquer código; real usa TOTP Nest.

nodes.label: /v1/auth/* (15)
nodes.note: Públicas: register/verify/resend/login/refresh/forgot/reset/mfa-verify (@Public). Resto JWT+Session.

nodes.label: tabelas-via-db-push
nodes.note: Sem migrations (Fase 1): `prisma db push` por domínio. updatedAt=@default(now()) e outbox sempre com id (SQL cru ignora defaults client-side).

nodes.label: credencial-root
nodes.note: register (TERMS+PRIVACY) → ativação direta/verify → login. Admin UI em mock aceita qualquer login.
